description: This file defines a PHP script that runs during the 'PostSave' event of an 'InboundEmail' entity in SuiteCRM. It performs checks and updates related to inbound email ownership and user settings, ensuring proper assignment and default server configurations for inbound emails based on the current user and focus object properties.

methods.name: PostSave
methods.description: This script runs after an inbound email record is saved, managing ownership and user outbound server settings based on certain conditions.
